notes.title: Update v.0.6.0
notes.content:
Howdy harvesters!!!

We apologize for the lack of activity. We have been working on rebuilding the basics of the game to create a stable system for Death Harvest development.

What's new in the beta:
1. Save system
2. Backpack
3. New story tutorial
4. New lighting
5. New building interiors
6. Dialogue system
7. New data pad
8. New main characters

What's been rebuilt:
1. Refactored weapons visually and systemically
2. Refactored inventory
3. Refactored Outpost missions
4. More types of zombies and rebuilt AI
5. New main characters
6. Rebuilt mission system
7. Rebuilt AI spawn management system

What's in the next update:
1. Colony hub level between missions with possibility of:
 a. Making purchases
 b. Selling loot
 c. Using the shooting range
 d. Mission selection
2. Warehouse mission and boss fight.
3.  Melee weapons.
4. AI companions in the colony.

Thank you for your patience, Death Harvest team!

notes.title: Update v.0.4.0 - New map and game mode
notes.content:
Hi everyone! What's new in this update?

New level: Military Warehouses - secure supplies for the colony and collect zombie mutagen samples.
Level modification: Outpost - added a preparation phase before waves, introduced new loot, and added a power generator mechanic.
Mechanic modification: Flashlight - now the beam of light follows your head and shines where you look.
Mechanic modification: Energy drink effect boosts stamina regeneration for a certain time instead of a one-time renewal.
Effect modification: Blood - new hit effects.
Added: Lootable crates.
Added: Radio.
Added: Pump-action and semi-automatic shotguns.
Added: Openable doors.
Added: Occlusion of sound effects.
Added: Food items that regenerate health.
... and many smaller fixes and mechanics that don't make sense to list individually.

notes.title: Update v.0.3.7 - New weapons pack
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We are constantly working on new additions as well as improvements to Death Harvest!

In this update, the main content will be 4 new weapons, including 2 submachine guns, 1 bulllpup and an automatic rifle, and QoL-oriented fixes.

The SMGs are well-known MP5 and UMP-45, small handy, but still shooting pistol ammunition so you need to shoot accurately to kill zombies! 
UMP has the first iteration of visualization mechanic of all the ammunition in the magazine, so if you fire a round it will change amount of ammunition in magazine model which is visible to all players.

notes.title: Update v.0.3.6 - Controllers offset and physics improvements
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Another week has passed, and we've been working on more improvements, more specifically, user experience! The first issue we addressed was the "stuttering" of hands and weapons, which was getting worse at lower FPS, after the changes it is buttery smooth!

[previewyoutube=z2mJ27e9xTk;full][/previewyoutube]

Another improvement is the operation of the front grip in weapons, previously when grabbed with a support hand the weapon changed its angle which was problematic, we have changed this to a system where the weapon maintains its direction when grabbed, this significantly improves the use of the front grip.
Together with those two changes we also tweaked the recoil of the weapons, from now on shooting rifles while holding them with one hand is more difficult.

[previewyoutube=nWB8ibu7tiU;full][/previewyoutube]

The last big change is the addition of an option to customize the offset of your controllers. This option is located in the main menu in the game and allows you to edit the offset in either direction so that everyone can customize it for themselves. We have also added presets for a couple of popular controllers, if you have different ones then send your offset, controller name and we will add them to the selection!

[previewyoutube=fsr-fN37qS8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are pleased to announce that we have updated the game, some of the features included in this update:

And a lot of other tweaks and fixes!

notes.title: Next week update annoucement
notes.content:
Hello, reapers!

We're running final test of our next-week update! We're quite excited, because it improves game feeling significantly!

Main three features brought in this update will be:

- Four new weapons! A battle rifle, machine pistol and two handguns! Two of these are very well known in popculture and we think you'll have a blast using them :)
- Gore system. Because these pesky zombies don't need all these arms and legs! Includes full and partial limb gore. And while we're trying to keep our FX lean (remember, our final goal is open-world survival! We  have to save CPU and GPU performance for that!), it turned out very enjoyable! Ammo usage in our testing team skyrocketed, because they started going full auto to rip these limb instead of popping well-aimed headshots like before :)
- And finally, sales system! A rifle you don't want anymore? Or maybe a fallen comrade weapon? Just sell it and use the funds for your own gain! This is also a testing bed for future trading systems. We're doing everything one step at a time, but we'll get there!
